children: On-chain investigator Specter said DPRK bridged $38 million through RelayProtocol Bridge in seven hours and was continuing to move funds. According to Odaily, Specter said Relay’s claimed KYT system had not stopped the transfers, adding that DPRK could not launder the funds through THORChain in such a short time and that Relay had opened a channel for the activity.

title: Specter Says DPRK Bridged $38 Million Through RelayProtocol in Seven Hours and Is Still Moving Funds
